name: 30058 · Lithonia, GA
findings: ZIP 30058 (Lithonia) has 264 nonprofit organizations. 74 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 49 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30058 (Lithonia) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 30058 (Lithonia) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 73 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.
